map.Hill 密码按固定长度分组（2×2 矩阵则每 2 个字母一组），每组独立做矩阵: The Hill cipher groups the text into fixed-length blocks (2 letters per block for a 2×2 matrix) and multiplies each block by the matrix independently. If the same two letters fall on different block boundaries — because padding was inserted earlier — they are paired with different neighbours, so the ciphertext differs. A short final block is usually padded with X or Z, which must be stripped after decryption.
